game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ash barrier.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: In Basalt Stair, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the ash barrier. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the power_on value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about power_on to power up the forge smith and open the ash barrier.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Basalt Stair.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
